scoring: rpn = severity x likelihood x (6 - detectability); >=60 is critical

risks.hazard: U1 dissipates 0.66 W at 5.5 V in, 300 mA out
risks.mitigation: 2 cm2 copper on the tab; Tj calculation in POWER.json; measured at S7

risks.hazard: AMS1117 specified for ESR > 0.1 ohm output capacitor; 22 uF ceramic may oscillate
risks.mitigation: 0.5 ohm series resistor in the C3 branch; load-step test at S7; alternate regulator if unstable
risks.trigger: ringing or oscillation on the load-step scope capture

risks.hazard: Parts not verified against a supplier API in this environment
risks.mitigation: alternates listed; supplier check required before ordering (GAP-02)
risks.trigger: any part out of stock or NRND at order time

risks.hazard: Hand-solder assembly of 0603 and SOT-223 by a first-time builder
risks.mitigation: footprint record with courtyard, visual inspection, pre-power continuity check

risks.hazard: Terminal block pads take insertion force with no through-hole plating support
risks.mitigation: 2 mm pads, 2.0 mm annulus, avoid rework on these pads

risks.hazard: Reverse connection of the input terminal
risks.mitigation: D1 series Schottky blocks reverse current; silkscreen marks + and -

risks.hazard: Untrusted datasheet text could contain instructions
risks.mitigation: datasheet text is treated as data; no tool call is derived from it without a recorded decision
